sections.heading: HomePod and the Environment
sections.source_text:
HomePod is designed with the following features to reduce its environmental impact:
12

Made with better materials
100% recycled rare earth elements in the speaker magnet
100% recycled tin in the solder of multiple printed circuit boards
100% recycled gold in the plating of multiple printed circuit boards
35% or more recycled plastic in multiple components
100% recycled plastic in the Midnight mesh fabric and nearly 30% recycled plastic in the White mesh fabric
